text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It's not every day I see you
snacking.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am not "snacking," exactly. I went to
purchase a
new notebook at the school
store, and the clerk
very kindly added a
treat to my bag.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know which lady you mean! She's
so sweet.
She really thinks of us students
like her own kids.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...But you don't seem overly enthusiastic
about it,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately. I am not permitted to eat
outside
my scheduled meals, so I have
been unsure what
to do with this.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Please, if it would not be too much
trouble, could
I ask you to eat this in my
stead?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Oh? As in, you're giving it to me?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And while this may be
presumptuous of me
to ask—may I hear
your opinion of the flavor?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I would very much like to provide that

information when I go to thank the clerk
properly,
as I will be explaining the
circumstances as to why
I could not
consume the treat personally.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So you can't eat it, but you're still going
to go
give her an official thanks?
...Hehe, you're a
sweet one too, Ruby.
